title: SAIL Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 03 Dresser Cum Compounder Posts
description: Steel Authority of India (SAIL) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 03 Dresser Cum Compounder Jobs. Candidates who have completed their B.Sc. Nursing, GNM, ANM, or 12th can grab this chance and apply for the SAIL Notification 2026 . Here we provide more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can attend the walk-in at the address mention...
